question_text: Two clubs supply lists of member IDs, club_a and club_b. An ID can occur more than once in either list. Construct compare_members(club_a, club_b) in Python. Return a tuple containing three sets in this order: IDs in both clubs; IDs in club_a but not club_b; IDs in at least one club. Each ID must occur only once in a returned set. Set order is irrelevant. Do not modify the input lists. You may use Python set operations.
